text: Welcome.
This is a little time to let your whole body unwind.
Thank yourself for making room for this.
Settle into a comfortable position.
Let your breathing find an easy rhythm.
Follow what feels comfortable for you.
Bring your attention to the top of your head.
Soften the small muscles around your eyes and forehead.
Let your neck and jaw soften.
Let your shoulders settle.
Allow your arms and hands to rest.
Notice the rise and fall of your chest.
Let your abdomen move gently with your breathing.
Give your lower back a little room to soften.
Notice the support beneath your thighs and hips.
Let your calves and knees rest.
Let your feet rest, all the way to the tips of your toes.
Notice your whole body resting here.
Give yourself permission to rest.
Begin to notice the room around you.
Gently move your fingers and toes.
Let your eyes open at your own pace.
Take this little bit of kindness with you.
